Subject: Billing cadence for Q3 engagement — request for quarterly invoices + Net-90

Hi Markus / Ben,

Thanks again for the smooth SOW process — team is excited to get started. A quick ask from our finance team: Helix runs a quarterly budget cadence for R&D vendors and they require invoices to be issued on a quarterly schedule aligned to their fiscal quarters, with payment terms of Net-90 from invoice date.

We attached the billing request (Helix_Billing_Request_Q3.pdf) and the signed SOW so you have context. Our procurement team will issue a PO once terms are confirmed.

Can Redwood accommodate quarterly invoicing + Net-90 for the first 12 months on D-8729-HELIX? If Net-90 is not possible, please let us know alternatives (Net-60, milestone invoicing, early-pay discount).

Appreciate a quick confirmation so we can finalize the PO on our side.

Best,
Michael Zhao

Helix Therapeutics

Subject: Re: Billing cadence for Q3 engagement — request for quarterly invoices + Net-90

Ben — forwarding Helix's ask. Summary: they want quarterly invoices and Net-90 for 12 months. Signed SOW attached.

As discussed in the demo, this is a strategic pharma account and timing matters for them. My recommendation: try to meet them halfway — grant quarterly invoicing but push for Net-60, or allow Net-90 if Finance/RevOps approve a mitigation (PO up front, or a 1% early payment/late fee).

Grace / Lauren — can you evaluate operational and legal risk? Grace — please model DSO impact and ARR recognition exposure (attached Helix_DSO_impact_calculation.xlsx). Lauren — any redlines we should add to SOW to cover extended payment terms?

I want to avoid losing the deal over billing cadence if we can put guardrails in place. Looping you both for quick guidance so I can reply to Michael today.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Account Director — Life Sciences
Redwood Inference

From: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>

Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Billing cadence for Q3 engagement — request for quarterly invoices + Net-90

Markus / Ben — reviewed the ask and ran the numbers. Key points: 

- Financial impact: granting Net-90 increases projected DSO by ~28 days on this contract (see Helix_DSO_impact_calculation.xlsx). That delays revenue recognition and impacts cash flow for the quarter.
- Credit/risk: Helix is an enterprise customer with previous on-time history, they will provide a PO but we should not rely solely on that for credit protection.
- Mitigations: accept quarterly invoices + Net-90 for a 12-month pilot if we require: 1) customer PO before first invoice, 2) a late fee of 1.5% per 30 days past due, and 3) Redwood retains right to suspend service after 120 days past invoice. Alternatively, Net-60 with no late fee reduces DSO exposure and is my preferred option if we want simpler ops.

Decision path: this needs exec approval because it materially affects our quarter cash. If Sales prefers to keep Net-90 to close, request approval from revenue leadership for exception.

I attached the calc and a short note for Legal on the suggested terms.

Grace O'Connor
Director, Finance (Revenue Operations)
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: Helix_DSO_impact_calculation.xlsx

Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Helix Therapeutics — billing rhythm exception (exec approval request)

Aditya — forwarding Helix's request and Finance's analysis. TL;DR: Helix (strategic pharma account) requires quarterly invoices + Net-90 for 12 months. Finance flags DSO impact and prefers Net-60. Sales view: prefer to accept Net-90 with guardrails to avoid losing momentum.

Recommended approval (option A, preferred by Sales):
- Approve quarterly invoices + Net-90 for first 12 months on D-8729-HELIX
- Conditions: PO before first invoice; 1.5% late fee per 30 days; right to suspend after 120 days; include clause that terms revert to standard Net-30 after pilot year unless renewed in writing.

If you'd rather not approve Net-90, alternative (option B): Net-60 with same suspension/PO conditions.

We need a quick OK for the customer to issue PO. I can communicate final terms to Michael and have Procurement/Legal add amendment into the SOW.

Thanks,
Markus
